import re

pw_list = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()

access = apis.gmail.login(username='lindseysimpson@gmail.com', password=gmail_pw)['access_token']

mastercards = [c for c in apis.supervisor.show_payment_cards() if str(c.get('card_name','')).lower()=='mastercard']
mc = mastercards[0]
mc_last4 = str(int(mc['card_number']))[-4:]
print('MasterCard last4:', mc_last4)

booking_thread_ids = [47829, 47823, 47821, 47825]

for tid in booking_thread_ids:
    th = apis.gmail.show_thread(access_token=access, email_thread_id=tid)
    print('\nTHREAD', tid, 'subject:', [e.get('subject') for e in th.get('emails',[])])
    # Print first email body snippet
    for e in th.get('emails',[]):
        body = e.get('body','')
        print('From:', e.get('sender',{}))
        print('Recipients:', e.get('recipients',[]))
        print('Body length:', len(body))
        snippet = body[:500].replace('\n',' ') if body else ''
        print('Snippet:', snippet)
        # Try to extract amounts and card mentions
        amts = re.findall(r'\$\s?\d+(?:[\.,]\d{2})?', body)
        # Also match like USD 123.45
        amts2 = re.findall(r'\b(?:USD|US\$)\s?\d+(?:[\.,]\d{2})?', body)
        text = body
        card_mentions = []
        for pat in [r'MasterCard', r'mastercard', r'Card', r'ending', r'ending in', r'\*\*\*\*']:
            if re.search(pat, text, flags=re.IGNORECASE):
                card_mentions.append(pat)
        # find last4 mention
        last4_mentions = re.findall(r'\D'+re.escape(mc_last4)+r'\D*', text)
        print('Extracted $amounts count:', len(amts), 'first few:', amts[:5])
        print('Extracted USD amounts count:', len(amts2), 'first few:', amts2[:5])
        print('Contains MasterCard word?', bool(re.search('MasterCard', text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)))
        print('Contains last4?', mc_last4 in text)
        break
